blocks.text: Woh angle θ jo batata hai ke kisi instant (lamha) par alternating voltage ya current ki qeemat kya hai, phase kehlata hai. Voltage aur current ki instantaneous qeematein:
Yani jo angle alternating quantity (miqdar) ki qeemat deta hai, woh phase hai (θ = ωt).

blocks.alt: +Vo aur -Vo ke darmiyan alternating voltage ka aik green cycle. Axis (kitab ki tarah 2 theta = omega t likha) par points A, B, C, D aur E phases 0, pi/2, pi, 3 pi/2 aur 2 pi par hain; kitab ki tarah sirf pi/2, 3 pi/2 aur 2 pi likhe hain.

blocks.text: Points A, B, C, D aur E ke phase 0, π/2, π, 3π/2 aur 2π hain (Fig. 17.5(a)). Is tarah AC cycle ka har point ek phase se pehchana (identify) jata hai.
